numerical_failure.observed_behavior: scipy.special.i1(713.0) returns inf, and scipy.special.i0(713.0) returns inf, although the true results are finite and representable in float64 (below the float64 maximum 1.7976931348623157e+308). The scaled scipy.special.i1e(713.0) remains finite (0.014938798768828885).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: scipy.special.i1(713.0) should return approximately 6.700424559186402e+307 and scipy.special.i0(713.0) should return approximately 6.705128263670996e+307, both finite.
trigger_conditions: unscaled i0 or i1 evaluated at x = 713.0 as np.float64
the result is finite in float64 but the implementation overflows to inf prematurely
the scaled variant i1e(713.0) does not overflow

numerical_characteristics.precision: Reference values computed with mpmath at 50-digit precision; the discrepancy is that the float64 result of i0/i1 at x=713 overflows to inf while the true value (~6.7e307) is below float64 max 1.7976931348623157e+308; the scaled i1e(713.0) remains finite (0.014938798768828885).
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Input x=713.0 where the result (~6.7e307) is just below the float64 maximum (~1.8e308); overflow to inf occurs at this input.
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: rtol=1e-6 in the issue reproducer assertion; rtol=5e-15, atol=0 in the regression test test_gh_25823 added by the fix.
category_specific_evidence: scipy.special.i1(713.0) returns inf while expected is approximately 6.700424559186402e+307
scipy.special.i0(713.0) returns inf while expected is approximately 6.705128263670996e+307
Reference values were computed with mpmath at high precision / 50-digit precision
The scaled variant i1e(713.0) remains finite (0.014938798768828885), indicating premature overflow in the unscaled implementation
cupy results for the same input are finite and match the expected value
Fix is an xsf subproject update (commit f230b63 -> 1254d0e) with regression test test_gh_25823 parametrized over i0 and i1 at x=713.0
PR #25981 closes issues #25823 and #25824 and is titled as fixing premature overflow in i0 and i1
reproduction_risks: Reproduction depends on the xsf subproject version; the pre-fix commit f230b637b3227de9248aef474e3de35675a2cde7 is needed to observe the bug
Expected values are from mpmath and were not verified against the implementation within the passages
Reproducer asserts np.isclose with rtol=1e-6 while the regression test uses rtol=5e-15; the separation tolerance between correct and incorrect answers is therefore ambiguous
